div.div: لَقِيتُ فُلَانًامُرَنِّقَةً عَيْنَاهُ (so in one of my copies of the S, and in the PS and JM; in the other of my copies of the S مُرَنَّقَةً;) (assumed tropical:) I met such a one having his eyes languid by reason of hunger or from some other cause. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
